requiredRebuildSequence.note: SEQ-3 follows SEQ-2. Its dark+compact control separately proves nonliteral theme/density inference rather than merely retaining an already-light base. No phrase-wide or fixture-ID production branches.

changes.dependsOn: explicit/semantic => []; dependent => only field=chartSize,value=large,dependsOn=[emphasis], design.emphasis=charts with valid emphasis change

plannerEnvelopeContract.mergeRule: Only independently judged approvedChanges become mask; final=normalize({...requestTimeBase,...approvedChangeValues}). Schema/span checks alone do not prove semantic relevance.
plannerEnvelopeContract.unknownIntent: No approved intent => preserve base/default with CUSTOMIZATION_NOT_APPLIED; incomplete coverage => approved subset only, standard fallback with CUSTOMIZATION_PARTIAL.

output.approvedChanges: 0..14unique Change; field schema and span/scope/dependency checked; value may correct candidate and is not required to equal candidate.design[field]
output.rejectedFields: 0..14unique supported fields removed entirely; disjoint approved fields

semanticJudge.trustBoundary: LLM semantic judgment can be wrong. Host guarantees no field outside approvedChanges changes, not perfect interpretation. Required real-judge negative QA is separate from mocked host-merge QA.

budgetRules: planner and judge and retries share total3calls
planner1 parse failure->planner2->judge3; no later model call
judge2 parse failure->judge3 with same candidate
third call after sandbox failure may not change judge-approved intent; changed intent rejected and standard fallback
no budget for judge => no generated success
